scope: QA-21, QA-22, QA-23 supplemental change-locality evaluation

candidate_meaning.B: three staged semantic authorities with explicit correction contracts
candidate_meaning.B_PRIME: B plus a non-architectural deterministic fast-path tactic; same element ledger as B

source_campaign.reuse_rule: Reuse v5 source_execution_key observations by reference only; do not copy them as new samples and do not rerun them.

execution.baseline: Each change starts from the same frozen candidate ledger; changes are never cumulative.

operations.M: Modify one existing frozen Architecture Element.
operations.A: Add one new independent Architecture Element.

execution.zero_rule: Zero is valid only when the frozen architecture absorbs the change through configuration without changing an Architecture Element.
execution.source_anchor_rule: Every frozen baseline element must have an existing repository anchor before execution.
execution.completion_rule: The per-change preserved-capability and completion contract must remain recorded; this design-ledger campaign does not claim product runtime regression execution.

aggregation.primary: Arithmetic mean of changed Architecture Element count across every required change in the QA pack.
aggregation.rounding: Report primary means to two decimal places; preserve exact numerator and denominator in raw evidence.

limitations: This campaign executes a source-anchored Architecture Element ledger, not a product code migration.
It measures structural change locality, not implementation effort, lines of code, or elapsed development time.
B_PRIME shares B's element ledger because its fast path is a tactic, not a separate Architecture structure.
